applicable_when: The kernel is a GEMM (M=1024, N=1024, K=8192) with ALLOW_TF32=False, forcing all dot-product accumulation through FP32 FFMA units (67 TFLOPS peak). The H200 SXM5 has 989 TFLOPS FP32 Tensor Core throughput — roughly 14.7x more than FFMA. Enabling TF32 (allow_tf32=True) routes tl.dot through Tensor Cores, delivering ~8x throughput improvement for the dot product. The kernel is severely underutilized: 168 registers/thread limits occupancy to 6.25% achieved. The 8-way shared memory bank conflicts (60% estimated speedup) and tiny BLOCK_K=32 (256 loop iterations for K=8192) compound the problem.
